subdomain.name: Payments
subdomain.capability: Orchestrate domestic, instant P2P and cross-border transfers across internal accounts and external clearing networks.
subdomain.why_distinct: Owns the payment lifecycle and two-phase authorization/settlement flow, with clearing network integrations.

ubiquitous_language.definition: External network such as ACH, SWIFT or SEPA.
Hold requested from Accounts for a payment.
Release of the hold after clearing failure.

bounded_contexts.name: Payment Orchestration
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Drive a payment order through screening, FX lock, reservation, clearing and settlement.
invariants: Balance reservation must be requested before initiating an outgoing transfer
Execution is two-phase: Authorization then Settlement
Clearing failure triggers automatic release of the reserved hold (Reversal)
Cross-border above 10000 USD equivalent requires FX settlement and AML clearance before execution

assumptions.item: Payment lifecycle events beyond PaymentRequestedEvent (e.g. settled, failed) are not listed.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Settlement confirmation currently flows as commands to Accounts and General Ledger.

assumptions.item: Flow A has Payments directing Accounts and General Ledger; the event list says Ledger reacts to hold events.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Orchestration vs choreography affects integration, not ownership.
